name: Flash
description: A four-armed flash: two crossed sectors meeting at the centre.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 348deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 24deg, transparent 24deg 90deg); mask: repeating-conic-gradient(from 348deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 24deg, transparent 24deg 90deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 22deg, 45deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 22deg, 45deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
